description: A wide run of packed gravel and grit, graded flat by traffic and rain into something almost like a road. Here it forks: a short, oddly immaculate spur of poured white ferrocrete peels off west toward a wall of mirror-chrome, out of place against all this grit. Puddles stand in the ruts, skinned with a chemical sheen. Nothing grows in the margins.
name: Halcyon Boulevard
